rec.name: Article Page Sticky Sidebar & Inline Product Cards (Metaobject-driven)
rec.status: Built — launched (price spacing fix confirmed by client)

what.text: An article/blog-style content section ("CRO | Sidebar + Article", template section ed_article_with_sidebar) used on a pest-control content page. The long-form article text sits in the main column. A sidebar column holds a product card, and a similar product card is embedded inline within the article body. Each card shows the product image, title, "from" price ("Ab €19,90"), a small per-item price ("€19,90/item"), and a green "Quick view" (Schnellansicht) button. The content of the cards is pulled from a Shopify metaobject (cro_sidebar_article) rather than hard-coded.

why.text: Content pages attract readers with informational intent (e.g. identifying ants or beetles). Placing the relevant solution product right next to or inside the educational content converts that research intent into a product visit without forcing the reader to navigate away. The quick-view button lowers friction, and the 'from' price plus unit price give instant price clarity.

how.text: Build a theme section with an article/rich-text column plus a sidebar column. Create a metaobject definition (cro_sidebar_article) with fields such as image and linked product(s) or title/price, and have the section read entries from it so merchandisers can change the cards without touching code. Render the cards as white rounded boxes with a soft shadow: a vertical card in the sidebar, and a horizontal card (image left, text right) within the article body. The CTA button opens the product quick view. Style the price block with the 'from' price above a smaller grey per-item price, and make sure spacing and alignment are consistent. The client asked for a small price spacing adjustment, which was fixed.

items: Sidebar product card (image, title, price, per-item price)

dependencies.text: Shopify metaobject definition 'cro_sidebar_article' (with an image field and product references). The theme needs a quick-view modal/feature (the 'Schnellansicht' button). The section was built in a custom theme with a page template (pages/pest-control-b).

items: Click-through rate on sidebar/inline product cards
Revenue per session on content pages
